title.rendered: Hot 5 CVs of a Remote JavaScript Developer

content.rendered:
JavaScript was initially released as a frontend scripting language for web applications that can integrate with HTML and Java, but it has gone a long way since its inception. Today, JavaScript is almost boundless in its applications, as it can be used in any layer of a web application, works on any platform, and can be integrated with any language and framework. An excellent JavaScript developer is therefore invaluable in any web project.

We are going to check out a few JavaScript resume samples and what skills and experience every JavaScript developer should have.

JavaScript Libraries and Frameworks

A JavaScript library is a collection of pre-written JavaScript codes that perform useful and commonly used functions, while a JavaScript framework is a collection of libraries that may be used for complete development. A good JavaScript developers for hire should use JavaScript libraries and frameworks to speed up development. Here are some popular JavaScript libraries and frameworks:

  • JQuery
  • React
  • AngularJS
  • D3.js
  • Vue.js
  • Polymer.js
  • Ember.js

Skills Every JavaScript Resume Should Possess

To find a real expert in Node.js consulting who would fit your projects are requirements may be extremely difficult, however, Mobilunity wants to point out the general and major skills every JavaScript developer resume should include.

  • Knowledge of core language (APIs, Library APIs, jQuery, React, TypeScript, the many npm packages out there, etc)
  • Understanding of Asynchronous code
  • Master of JavaScript language
  • Expert of design tasks
  • Understanding of networking and HTTP-based APIs
  • Comfortable with at least two JS frameworks and have experience with it, including familiarity with Vue.js through the guidance of experienced Vue.js experts.

Also, the knowledge of the following would be inevitable:

  • HTML/CSS
  • JQuery
  • CSS preprocessing
  • Version control/Git
  • Responsive design
  • Testing/debugging
  • Browsing developer tools
  • Command line

JavaScript Developer CV

To give you a better idea of the typical part time JavaScript developer background and skills, here are 5 JavaScript resume samples that Mobilunity will be glad to provide you with.

CV#1 Senior JavaScript Sample Resume

Experience

  • Development of video streaming and hosting web applications using JavaScript, ExtJS, NodeJS, C, C++, and Ruby
  • Involvement in a full overhaul of web applications, including frontend enhancements and backend architectural modifications
  • Development of an automation application for data encoding and inventory of a television company
  • In-depth analysis and debugging of application crashes and issues
  • Development of a web application for a set-top box

Technologies

  • HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Node.js, JQuery, XML, PHP, Restful API, AJAX, Backbone.js, Express.js, C++, C, Java, Python, Ruby, CVS, Subversion, Git, Eclipse IDE, Rails, MVC, JSON, Cucumber, Rspec, Apache, Jenkins, SDLC Waterfall, Agile, SCRUM, Windows 7, XP, NT, MacOS X, Ubuntu 10/11, RHEL 5-6

CV#2 Senior Resume JavaScript

Experience

  • Involvement in the optimization of web applications, including identification of issues, the conceptualization of solutions, and code implementation
  • Expertise in developing mobile-responsive web applications using media queries
  • Translation of business requirements into web wireframes and UI layouts
  • Usage of migration tools to upgrade framework versions

Skills

  • HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Bootstrap, XML, JavaScript, Typescript, Bootstrap, AJAX, JSP, UI, Angular.JS1, Angular.JS2, Express.js, PHP, Backbone.js, JQuery, Circle CI JSON, Polymer.js, Ember.js, Node.js, React.js, Eclipse IDE, CVS, GIT, Apache Tomcat, HTTP Web Server, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB

CV#3 Middle JavaScript Engineer Resume

Experience

  • Development of a project management web application using JavaScript, Python and Django
  • Frontend development of an e-learning web application using HTML5 and JavaScript
  • Development of a web-based database user interface for a medical company
  • Maintenance of a real estate agency website

Technologies

  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, ImpactJS, Python, Django, SDL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, C++, Linux, Nginx, Github, TensorFlow …

CV#4 Middle JavaScript Developer CV Example

Experience

  • Involvement in developing JavaScript APIs for a banking application
  • Development of mobile-friendly web applications with support for multiple languages
  • Full-stack development of a network router accessing the application using AngularJS and Node.js

Skills

  • HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, JSON, PHP, MySQL, NodeJS, CoffeeScript, ExpressJS, Jade, SQL, PHP, MongoDB, JIRA

CV#5 Junior JavaScript Developer CV

Experience

  • Development of timeline functionality for a resource planning application using pure JavaScript
  • Debugging of issues in an existing website for a pharmaceutical company using JQuery
  • Usage of AngularJS to create a web survey form

Skills

  • HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, Materialize, SASS, Moment.js, Java, Apache Tomcat, Git, Apache Subversion, Eclipse IDE …
